papers.title: Del immune V and microbiome restructuring in colorectal cancer surgery: a randomized double blind placebo controlled trial
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: García G, Díaz A, Fernández L, Bernal M, Soto J, Núñez G
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The gut microbiome is increasingly recognized as a central factor in carcinogenesis. Dietary components and therapeutic interventions, including probiotics, may influence microbial composition and function, thereby modulating cancer risk. Del-Immune V, a metabiotic supplement derived from Lactobacillus rhamnosus, has demonstrated immunomodulatory properties. This study investigates its role in microbiome restructuring and patient-reported outcomes in colorectal cancer patients during the perioperative period.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A randomized, controlled, double-blind Phase I trial was conducted in 39 colorectal cancer patients undergoing elective resection, assigned to Del-Immune V (n=22) or placebo (n=17). Participants received two capsules daily (100 mg each), starting 7-15 days before surgery and continuing until 15 days postoperatively. Blood and fecal samples were collected at baseline and day 60 to assess IL-6, CRP, CEA, and microbiome composition. Patient-reported outcomes were measured using the EORTC QLQ-C30 questionnaire. Microbiome profiling was performed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing with PICRUSt-based functional inference.
RESULTS: Del-Immune V significantly reduced IL-6 (p=0.012) and supported CRP decline, while quality-of-life scores improved across multiple domains. Microbiome analyses revealed enrichment of short-chain fatty acid-producing genera (Bifidobacterium, Agathobacter, Gemmiger, Phocaeicola) and decline of CRC-associated taxa (Fusobacterium), with a significant improvement in the dysbiosis index (p=0.024).
CONCLUSIONS: Del-Immune V demonstrated immunomodulatory activity, evidenced by reductions in IL-6 and CRP, alongside improvements in patient-reported quality of life. These effects were accompanied by restructuring of the gut microbiome, characterized by enrichment of protective commensals and reduction of CRC-associated taxa. Collectively, findings support Del-Immune V as a safe adjunctive therapy in colorectal cancer surgery, with potential to enhance recovery and long-term outcomes.
papers.title_zh: Del Immune V與大腸直腸癌手術中的微生物組重塑：一項隨機雙盲安慰劑對照試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：腸道微生物組已被廣泛認為是致癌作用的核心因子。飲食成分與治療性介入（包括益生菌）可能影響微生物組成與功能，進而調節癌症風險。Del-Immune V是一種源自鼠李糖乳桿菌（Lactobacillus rhamnosus）的代謝生物製劑，已展現免疫調節特性。本研究探討其在大腸直腸癌病人圍手術期對微生物組重塑與病人自述結果的作用。

方法：這是一項隨機、對照、雙盲第一期試驗，納入39位接受擇期切除手術的大腸直腸癌病人，分配至Del-Immune V組（n=22）或安慰劑組（n=17）。參與者每日服用兩顆膠囊（每顆100mg），自手術前7-15天開始，持續至術後15天。於基準值與第60天採集血液與糞便樣本，評估IL-6、CRP、CEA與微生物組成。病人自述結果以EORTC QLQ-C30問卷測量。微生物組分析採用16S rRNA基因定序與PICRUSt功能推論。

結果：Del-Immune V顯著降低IL-6（p=0.012）並支持CRP下降，同時多個生活品質面向皆有改善。微生物組分析顯示短鏈脂肪酸產生菌屬（Bifidobacterium、Agathobacter、Gemmiger、Phocaeicola）增加，與大腸直腸癌相關菌種（Fusobacterium）減少，菌相失調指數顯著改善（p=0.024）。

結論：Del-Immune V展現免疫調節活性，證據為IL-6與CRP的下降，並伴隨病人自述生活品質的改善。這些效果伴隨腸道微生物組的重塑，特徵為保護性共生菌增加與大腸直腸癌相關菌種減少。整體而言，研究結果支持Del-Immune V作為大腸直腸癌手術的安全輔助療法，具有促進恢復與改善長期預後的潛力。
papers.score_reason: 第一期小樣本試驗（n=39），僅評估替代指標（發炎標記、微生物組、QoL問卷），無臨床硬指標（吻合口漏、感染、復發、存活），對臨床決策尚無實用性。
papers.relevance_why: 屬於早期概念驗證研究，探討益生菌補充劑對微生物組與發炎標記的影響，尚未涉及可改變手術決策或臨床照護路徑的硬指標。

papers.title: Surgical Options in the Treatment of Rectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Medina A, Moga M, Pi O, Hogea A, Misarca C, Hogea M
papers.abstract: Background: Rectal surgery has evolved through the combined efforts of anatomists and surgeons. Minimally invasive surgery has gained recognition over open surgery due to fewer perioperative complications, and faster postoperative recovery. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science to identify studies published between 2014 and December 2024 comparing laparoscopic surgery (LS) and open surgery (OS) for rectal cancer. Primary outcomes included postoperative complications, number of lymph nodes harvested, overall survival, and disease-free survival. Results: Eight randomized controlled trials and one non-randomized study, including a total of 3,935 patients, were analyzed. LS showed a lower incidence of postoperative complications [OR: 0.64; 95% CI, 0.53, 0.77; p=0.008] and a slight advantage in lymph node harvest (WMD: 0.66; 95% CI: -0.63Ã¢?"1.95). No significant differences were found in overall or disease-free survival. Conclusions: LS is a safe and effective option for rectal cancer treatment, offering better postoperative recovery and efficient lymph node retrieval, while maintaining long-term oncological outcomes comparable to OS.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌手術選擇：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：直腸手術透過解剖學家與外科醫師的共同努力不斷演進。微創手術因併發症較少、術後恢復較快，已逐漸取代開腹手術獲得認可。方法：於PubMed、Scopus及Web of Science進行系統性搜尋，納入2014年至2024年12月間發表、比較腹腔鏡手術（LS）與開腹手術（OS）治療直腸癌之研究。主要結果指標包括術後併發症、淋巴結摘取數目、總體存活率及無病存活率。結果：共納入8篇隨機對照試驗及1篇非隨機研究，總計3,935名病人。LS術後併發症發生率較低〔OR: 0.64；95% CI, 0.53–0.77；p=0.008〕，淋巴結摘取數目略佔優勢（WMD: 0.66；95% CI: -0.63–1.95）。總體存活率與無病存活率兩組無顯著差異。結論：LS是治療直腸癌安全且有效的選擇，可提供較佳的術後恢復及有效的淋巴結摘取，同時維持與OS相當的長期腫瘤學結果。
papers.score_reason: 結論與COLOR II、ACOSOG Z6051等已知大型RCT一致，屬再確認性質而非新知；且摘要缺乏異質性分析、偏誤風險評估等關鍵方法學細節。
papers.relevance_why: LS vs OS為直腸癌手術核心議題，直接影響台灣大腸直腸外科日常手術決策。
papers.one_liner: 在3935名直腸癌病人（9篇研究）中，比較LS與OS，發現LS術後併發症較少（OR 0.64），存活與DFS無差異。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法，此結果與COLOR II等既有大型RCT一致，僅再次確認LS腫瘤學安全性。

papers.title: Methotrexate for inflammatory bowel disease: the MICI-METHO multicenter retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Caron B, Kirchgesner J, Nachury M, Bouguen G, Uzzan M, Buisson A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIM: Methotrexate has demonstrated efficacy in Crohn's disease (CD) as monotherapy and is increasingly used in combination therapy. We investigated for the first time the use of methotrexate in a very large cohort of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in a real-world setting.
METHODS: This was an observational, retrospective, multicenter study including consecutive adult IBD patients treated with methotrexate in monotherapy or combination therapy between January 2015 and December 2022 in 15 French centers.
RESULTS: Among the 1115 patients included, 77% had CD and 34.5% had at least one extra-intestinal manifestation (EIM). Regarding prior treatments, 44.0% of patients had been exposed to azathioprine and 75.1% to anti-tumor necrosis factor agents. The primary indication for methotrexate was IBD (81.5%), followed by EIM (rheumatological [11.9%] or dermatological [3.9%]). Methotrexate was prescribed in combination therapy in 90.6% of cases. The most frequent induction and maintenance dose was 15 mg/week (47.5% and 51.1% respectively). The persistence rate of methotrexate was 27.7 months in CD and 22.4 months in ulcerative colitis (UC). For CD, factors associated with persistence were female gender (hazard ratio [HR] 1.26; 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.05-1.51) and the presence of EIM (HR 0.71; 95% CI 0.58-0.86), and for UC, the presence of EIM (HR 0.63; 95% CI 0.42-0.94). Among the 344 (31.7%) patients who experienced an adverse event related to methotrexate, nine experienced a serious adverse event.
CONCLUSION: The French multicenter MICI-METHO study is the first to provide a comprehensive overview of the real-world use, persistence, and safety of methotrexate in patients with IBD.
papers.title_zh: methotrexate用於發炎性腸道疾病：MICI-METHO多中心回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：methotrexate已證實可作為克隆氏症（CD）單一療法且療效良好，並日益常用於合併療法。本研究首次在真實世界環境中，於大規模發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）病人族群中探討methotrexate的使用情形。
方法：這是一項觀察性、回溯性、多中心研究，納入2015年1月至2022年12月間於法國15個中心接受methotrexate單一療法或合併療法之連續成人IBD病人。
結果：共納入1115名病人，77%為CD，34.5%至少有一項腸道外表現（EIM）。先前治療方面，44.0%曾使用過azathioprine，75.1%曾使用過抗腫瘤壞死因子藥物。methotrexate的主要適應症為IBD本身（81.5%），其次為EIM（風濕科11.9%、皮膚科3.9%）。90.6%的病例採合併療法處方。最常見的誘導期與維持期劑量皆為每週15毫克（分別佔47.5%與51.1%）。methotrexate的持續使用時間在CD為27.7個月，在潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）為22.4個月。在CD中，與持續使用相關的因子為女性（風險比[HR] 1.26；95%信賴區間[CI] 1.05-1.51）以及有EIM（HR 0.71；95% CI 0.58-0.86）；在UC中則為有EIM（HR 0.63；95% CI 0.42-0.94）。344名（31.7%）病人發生與methotrexate相關的不良事件，其中9名發生嚴重不良事件。
結論：法國多中心MICI-METHO研究首次針對IBD病人使用methotrexate的真實世界使用情形、持續性與安全性提供完整概觀。

papers.title: From bench to bedside: advancing our understanding of radioresistance in rectal cancer
papers.authors: Estêvão D, da Cruz-Ribeiro M, Coelho D, Lencart J, Sousa O, Sarmento B
papers.abstract: The global incidence of rectal cancer (RC) is increasing at an alarming rate, with over 50% of cases still diagnosed at advanced stages, despite improvements in early detection. While neoadjuvant (chemo)radiotherapy regimens remain a cornerstone of treatment, up to 20-40% of tumours exhibit or develop resistance to ionising radiation, limiting therapeutic options and leading to disease evolution. This review offers a comprehensive insight into the complex biological and molecular mechanisms underlying RC radioresistance within the fundamental 6Rs of radiobiology: Repair, Reoxygenation, Redistribution, Radiosensitivity, Repopulation, and Reactivation. More specifically, DNA damage repair pathways, cell cycle regulation, hypoxia, transcriptional plasticity regulators such as cancer stem cells, and non-coding RNAs are comprehensively reviewed. Additionally, the critical roles of tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes, cancer-associated macrophages, and inflammatory cancer-associated fibroblasts in radioresistance are also dissected, which collectively shape an immunosuppressive and pro-metastatic niche following radiotherapy. Furthermore, a less explored mechanism, namely the metabolic rewiring of cancer cells after radiotherapy, is proposed as a new 7th R of Radiobiology, namely "Reprogramming", that enables tumour survival and promotes aggressive phenotypes. This new perspective adds a new layer of complexity to the molecular understanding of RC resistance and provides a mechanistic insight currently missing in radiobiology research. Additionally, advanced experimental models, such as spheroids, patient-derived organoids, and animal models, are discussed as valuable platforms for pre-clinical research and therapeutic testing. This review also integrates mechanistic insights with biomarker-guided clinical decision-making to support RC management. By unravelling these multifactorial mechanisms, we highlight opportunities to develop predictive biomarkers and tailored therapeutic strategies to overcome resistance and improve patient outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 從實驗桌到病床邊：增進我們對直腸癌放射抗性的理解
papers.abstract_zh: 直腸癌（RC）的全球發生率正以驚人速度上升，儘管早期偵測已有進展，仍有超過50%的病例在晚期才被診斷。雖然術前（化學）放射治療仍是治療基石，但高達20-40%的腫瘤呈現或發展出對游離輻射的抗性，限制了治療選項並導致疾病惡化。本篇綜述在放射生物學基本的6Rs框架下——修復（Repair）、再氧合（Reoxygenation）、再分佈（Redistribution）、放射敏感性（Radiosensitivity）、再增殖（Repopulation）、再活化（Reactivation）——提供對RC放射抗性背後複雜生物與分子機制的全面性洞見。更具體而言，本文全面回顧了DNA損傷修復路徑、細胞週期調控、缺氧、如癌症幹細胞等轉錄可塑性調節因子，以及非編碼RNA。此外，也剖析腫瘤浸潤淋巴球、癌症相關巨噬細胞、發炎性癌症相關纖維母細胞在放射抗性中的關鍵角色，這些因素共同形成放射治療後的免疫抑制與促轉移微環境。再者，本文提出一個較少被探討的機制——放射治療後癌細胞的代謝重編程——作為放射生物學的「第7個R」，即「重編程（Reprogramming）」，使腫瘤得以存活並促進侵襲性表型。這個新觀點為RC抗性的分子理解增添新的複雜層次，並提供目前放射生物學研究中缺乏的機制性洞見。此外，本文也討論了先進的實驗模型，如球狀體、病人來源類器官及動物模型，作為臨床前研究與治療測試的寶貴平台。本綜述也整合了機制性洞見與生物標記導向的臨床決策，以支持RC的管理。透過解析這些多因子機制，我們強調開發預測性生物標記與量身訂做治療策略以克服抗性、改善病人預後的機會。
papers.score_reason: 純機制性文獻回顧，無原創臨床數據，對明日臨床決策無直接影響，但對理解放療抗性機制及未來研究方向有參考價值。

papers.title: Comparative Performance of Postoperative Day 3 Biomarkers for Predicting Anastomotic Leakage after Colorectal Cancer Surgery - A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.authors: Ghirlea O, Paşca P, Georgescu D, Duţă C, Olariu S, Murariu M
papers.abstract: Background: Anastomotic leakage (AL) represents a serious postoperative complication after surgery, especially for digestive tract malignancies, concerning both patients and surgeons. Due to severe clinical repercussions, early identification of patients at risk is essential for improving postoperative outcomes. This study focused on assessing clinical risk factors and the postoperative day 3 (POD 3) biomarkers in early detection of anastomotic leakage. Materials and Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted including 166 patients who underwent resection with primary anastomosis for colorectal cancer. Patient-related factors, tumor characteristics, operative factors, and POD 3 laboratory data were collected. Receiver operating characteristics (ROC) curves and logistic regression models were used to assess predictive performance and identify independent risk factors. Results: Anastomotic leakage occurred in 44 patients (26.50%) and was associated with prolonged hospitalization and higher postoperative mortality (25.00% vs 6.60%, p=0.002). Multivariable logistic regression identified emergency surgery, rectal tumor location, intraoperative transfusion, and open surgical approach as independent risk factors. Among POD 3 biomarkers, C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy for AL. After adjustment in the multivariable model, CAR remained an independent predictor of AL (OR=1.91, p 0.001). Conclusions: Anastomotic leakage after colorectal cancer surgery remains a multifactorial complication influenced by operative conditions, local tumor-related factors, and the postoperative inflammatory response. In this retrospective cohort, POD 3 CAR showed the highest discriminatory performance among the evaluated biomarkers and may support early postoperative risk stratification when interpreted with clinical findings and operative risk factors.

papers.title_zh: 術後第三天生物標記預測大腸直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏之比較表現—回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：吻合口滲漏（AL）是消化道惡性腫瘤手術後的嚴重併發症，對病人與外科醫師皆造成極大關切。由於臨床後果嚴重，及早辨識高風險病人對改善術後預後至關重要。本研究聚焦於評估臨床危險因子與術後第三天（POD 3）生物標記在早期偵測吻合口滲漏中的角色。方法：本回溯性觀察研究納入166名接受大腸直腸癌切除併一期吻合手術的病人。收集病人相關因子、腫瘤特徵、手術相關因子及POD 3實驗室數據。使用受試者操作特徵（ROC）曲線與邏輯迴歸模型評估預測效能並辨識獨立危險因子。結果：44名病人（26.50%）發生吻合口滲漏，與住院時間延長及較高術後死亡率相關（25.00% vs 6.60%，p=0.002）。多變項邏輯迴歸分析顯示，急診手術、直腸腫瘤位置、術中輸血及開腹手術方式為獨立危險因子。在POD 3生物標記中，C反應蛋白與白蛋白比值（CAR）展現最高預測準確度。經多變項模型校正後，CAR仍為吻合口滲漏的獨立預測因子（OR=1.91，p<0.001）。結論：大腸直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏仍是受手術條件、局部腫瘤相關因子及術後發炎反應影響的多因子併發症。在此回溯性世代中，POD 3 CAR在所評估的生物標記中顯示最高鑑別效能，若能與臨床發現及手術危險因子合併判讀，或可協助早期術後風險分層。

papers.title: COLOSSUS-AI: A Pilot Study on Artificial Intelligence Driven Prediction of Postoperative Outcomes in Colorectal Surgery
papers.authors: Botoncea M, Cosma C, Nicolescu C, Butiurca V, Molnar D, Molnar C
papers.abstract: Background: Postoperative complications remain a major source of morbidity after colorectal surgery and are associated with prolonged hospitalization, reintervention, intensive care unit admission, and increased mortality. Early identification of high-risk patients remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of colorectal surgical populations. Artificial intelligence and machine learning methods may support individualized risk prediction by integrating clinical, biological, and operative variables. Aim: This study aimed to develop and internally evaluate a preliminary machine learning model, named COLOSSUS-AI, for predicting early postoperative adverse outcomes after colorectal surgery. Material and Methods: This retrospective, single-center, observational pilot study included 310 patients undergoing colorectal surgery. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, disease-specific, operative, and postoperative data were retrospectively collected and organized into a structured database comprising 84 variables. The primary endpoint was postoperative adverse outcome. Three predictive models were evaluated: logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting. Model performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic curve analysis, area under the curve, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Results: Postoperative adverse outcomes occurred in 120 patients (38.7%). Adverse outcomes were associated with older age, urgent or emergency admission, increased inflammatory markers, higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, lower preoperative albumin, impaired renal function parameters, anastomotic leak, and in-hospital mortality. Among the evaluated models, gradient boosting achieved the best predictive performance, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.886, accuracy of 81.7%, sensitivity of 72.2%, and specificity of 87.7%. Random forest achieved an area under the curve of 0.841, while logistic regression achieved an area under the curve of 0.768. Conclusions: The COLOSSUS-AI pilot study suggests that routinely collected perioperative data can be used to develop exploratory machine learning models for predicting postoperative adverse outcomes after colorectal surgery. Although gradient boosting showed the best preliminary performance, these findings should be interpreted cautiously. External validation in larger multicenter cohorts is required before clinical implementation.

papers.title_zh: COLOSSUS-AI：人工智慧預測大腸直腸手術術後結果之前導性研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：術後併發症仍是大腸直腸手術後主要的病態來源，與住院時間延長、再介入、加護病房入住及死亡率增加相關。由於大腸直腸手術族群異質性高，早期辨識高風險病人仍具挑戰性。人工智慧與機器學習方法或可整合臨床、生物與手術變項，支援個人化風險預測。目的：本研究旨在開發並進行內部評估一個名為COLOSSUS-AI的初步機器學習模型，用以預測大腸直腸手術後早期不良結果。材料與方法：此為回溯性、單中心、觀察性前導研究，納入310名接受大腸直腸手術的病人。回溯性收集人口學、臨床、實驗室、疾病特異性、手術及術後資料，建構包含84項變數的結構化資料庫。主要終點為術後不良結果。評估三種預測模型：邏輯迴歸、隨機森林及梯度提升。以受試者操作特徵曲線分析、曲線下面積、準確度、敏感度及特異度評估模型表現。結果：120名病人（38.7%）發生術後不良結果。不良結果與年齡較大、緊急或急診入院、發炎指標升高、嗜中性球與淋巴球比值升高、術前白蛋白較低、腎功能受損指標、吻合口漏及院內死亡有關。在評估的模型中，梯度提升表現最佳，受試者操作特徵曲線下面積為0.886，準確度81.7%，敏感度72.2%，特異度87.7%。隨機森林曲線下面積為0.841，邏輯迴歸曲線下面積為0.768。結論：COLOSSUS-AI前導研究顯示，常規收集的圍手術期資料可用於開發探索性機器學習模型以預測大腸直腸手術後不良結果。儘管梯度提升在初步表現上最佳，這些發現應審慎解讀。臨床應用前需在更大規模、多中心世代中進行外部驗證。

papers.title: Drug-associated inflammatory bowel disease: a real-world pharmacovigilance study using the FAERS and JADER databases
papers.authors: Ying Y, Shen M, Chen J, Feng T, Li Z, Ying Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Although several medications have been linked to inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the association between most drugs and IBD remains unclear. This study aimed to identify medications most frequently reported in connection with IBD by analyzing large-scale data from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) and the Japan Adverse Drug Event Report (JADER) database.
METHODS: We extracted reports of drug-associated IBD adverse events from FAERS and performed external validation using JADER. Disproportionality analyses of suspected drugs were conducted using four methods: Reporting Odds Ratio (ROR), Proportional Reporting Ratio (PRR), Bayesian Confidence Propagation Neural Network (BCPNN), and Multi-Item Gamma Poisson Shrinker (MGPS). Additional analyses included time-to-onset (TTO) assessment, Weibull distribution modeling, and subgroup analyses by age, sex, and IBD subtype to evaluate signal stability and clinical characteristics.
RESULTS: The FAERS database yielded 52,395 reports of drug-associated IBD, corresponding to 50,426 patients.Females accounted for a higher proportion of reports than males, with the majority of cases occurring in individuals aged 18-64 years. The annual number of reports showed an overall upward trend. Among drugs reported at least 50 times, 17 met all four algorithmic threshold criteria and were classified as positive signals. Anti-tumor necrosis factor-alpha (anti-TNF-α) inhibitors ranked highest by reporting frequency, whereas isotretinoin demonstrated the strongest signal intensity. External validation using JADER confirmed consistent signals for certain anti-TNF-α inhibitors, anti-interleukin biologic agents, conventional immunosuppressants, and antibiotics. Time-to-onset analysis revealed that the median onset of IBD occurred within one year for most drug-associated cases. The Weibull model indicated an "early failure-type" onset pattern for the majority of positive signals.
CONCLUSION: From a pharmacovigilance perspective, this study provides a comprehensive overview of medications associated with IBD, offering clinically relevant insights. Our findings deliver real-world evidence to support the identification and monitoring of drug-associated IBD; however, confirmation in large prospective cohort studies remains necessary.
papers.title_zh: 藥物相關發炎性腸道疾病：使用FAERS與JADER資料庫之真實世界藥物警戒研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：儘管已有多種藥物與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）相關聯，但大多數藥物與IBD之間的關聯仍不明確。本研究旨在透過分析美國食品藥物管理局不良事件通報系統（FAERS）與日本藥物不良事件報告資料庫（JADER）的大規模資料，找出與IBD最常被通報相關的藥物。

方法：我們從FAERS擷取藥物相關IBD不良事件報告，並使用JADER進行外部驗證。針對可疑藥物採用四種方法進行不成比例分析（disproportionality analyses）：報告勝算比（ROR）、比例通報比（PRR）、貝氏信賴傳播神經網路（BCPNN）及多項目伽瑪卜瓦松收縮法（MGPS）。另進行發病時間（TTO）評估、Weibull分布建模，並依年齡、性別及IBD亞型進行次群組分析，以評估訊號穩定性與臨床特徵。

結果：FAERS資料庫共納入52,395筆藥物相關IBD報告，對應50,426名病人。女性報告比例高於男性，多數病例發生於18-64歲族群。年度報告數呈現整體上升趨勢。在通報次數至少50次的藥物中，有17種同時符合四種演算法的門檻標準，被列為陽性訊號。抗腫瘤壞死因子-α（anti-TNF-α）抑制劑通報頻率最高，而異維A酸（isotretinoin）訊號強度最強。使用JADER進行外部驗證，證實部分抗TNF-α抑制劑、抗介白素生物製劑、傳統免疫抑制劑及抗生素之訊號一致。發病時間分析顯示，多數藥物相關IBD病例之中位發病時間在一年內。Weibull模型顯示多數陽性訊號呈現「早期失效型」發病模式。

結論：從藥物警戒的角度，本研究提供與IBD相關藥物的全面性概覽，提供臨床相關洞見。本研究結果提供真實世界證據，以支持藥物相關IBD之辨識與監測；然而仍需在大型前瞻性世代研究中加以確認。

papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此為藥物警戒假說生成研究，無法確立因果或建議停藥，僅供臨床警覺參考。

pico.I: 各類疑似藥物暴露（anti-TNF-α抑制劑、抗IL生物製劑、免疫抑制劑、抗生素、isotretinoin等）

cautions: 自發通報資料庫無分母、無法計算真實發生率或絕對風險，僅能偵測訊號、不能證明因果關係

unassessable: 盲法／allocation concealment（不適用於此類研究設計）

papers.title: Evaluating quality of colorectal cancer surgery across elective and emergency health systems: secondary analysis of prospective cohort studies in 95 countries
papers.authors: Kamarajah S, Adisa A, Aggarwal A, Berhe A, Glasbey J, Harrison E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The Lancet Oncology Commission on Global Cancer Surgery recommended that access to and the quality of surgical care be improved. This study aimed to understand differences in surgical quality between emergency and elective resection among patients with potentially curative colorectal cancer.
METHODS: This preplanned secondary analysis included patients undergoing only curative-intent surgery for colorectal cancer from three contemporary global prospective cohort studies (GlobalSurg-3, 5506 patients; CovidSurg-Cancer, 6719 patients; APOLLO, 876 patients) registered from 2018 to 2023. Hierarchical multilevel logistic regression models quantified associations between the urgency of surgery (elective versus emergency) and surgical quality, measured by margin-positive resection, adjusting for patient, disease, and health system factors. Bootstrap multivariable simulations evaluated effect modification by country income level, cancer stage, and location.
RESULTS: Of the 45 699 patients registered, 13 101 across 95 countries were included in this analysis. Overall, 678 patients (5.4%) had margin-positive resections, with higher rates in the emergency than elective surgery group (13.7 versus 4.5%; P < 0.0001). In adjusted multilevel models, emergency surgery was associated with increased odds of margin-positive resections (adjusted odds ratio 2.45, 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.86 to 3.22), consistent across all country income groups and robust to alternative health system indicators. Bootstrap-derived absolute risk differences revealed the greatest disparities in patients with stage III-IV rectal cancers, with absolute differences of 12.6% (95% c.i. 10.2 to 15.7) in high-income countries, 19.0% (95% c.i. 13.6 to 23.9) in upper middle-income countries, and 14.1% (95% c.i. 10.9 to 16.5) in lower middle- and low-income countries. Variance decomposition demonstrated that hospital- and country-level factors accounted for 76% of the explained variation in surgical quality.
CONCLUSION: Emergency surgery was associated with a two- to threefold increase in the risk of margin-positive resections globally, independent of resource availability, highlighting a neglected area of global surgical practice. These findings challenge the assumption that poorer outcomes after emergency surgery are due to advanced disease stage. For patients presenting as an emergency with potentially curative resection, enhanced decision-making around resectability, ensuring specialist surgeon availability, and developing bridge-to-surgery pathways represent immediate, low-cost strategies to improve global cancer outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 評估選擇性與急診醫療體系下大腸直腸癌手術品質：95國前瞻性世代研究之次分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：《刺胳針腫瘤學全球癌症手術委員會》建議應改善手術照護的可近性與品質。本研究旨在了解具潛在治癒性大腸直腸癌病人中，急診與選擇性手術之間手術品質的差異。
方法：本預先規劃之次分析納入三項當代全球前瞻性世代研究（GlobalSurg-3，5506名病人；CovidSurg-Cancer，6719名病人；APOLLO，876名病人）中僅接受根治性意圖手術之大腸直腸癌病人，登錄期間為2018至2023年。以階層式多層次邏輯迴歸模型量化手術急迫性（選擇性vs.急診）與手術品質（以切緣陽性切除定義）之關聯，並校正病人、疾病及醫療體系因素。以拔靴法（bootstrap）多變項模擬評估國家收入層級、癌症分期及腫瘤位置之效應修飾作用。
結果：45699名登錄病人中，共納入來自95國之13101名病人進行本分析。整體而言，678名病人（5.4%）發生切緣陽性切除，急診手術組發生率高於選擇性手術組（13.7% vs. 4.5%；P<0.0001）。經校正之多層次模型顯示，急診手術與切緣陽性切除機率增加相關（校正後勝算比2.45，95%信賴區間1.86至3.22），此結果在所有國家收入分組中皆一致，且對替代性醫療體系指標具穩健性。以拔靴法推算之絕對風險差異顯示，第三至四期直腸癌病人差異最大：高收入國家絕對差異為12.6%（95%信賴區間10.2至15.7），中高收入國家為19.0%（95%信賴區間13.6至23.9），中低及低收入國家為14.1%（95%信賴區間10.9至16.5）。變異數分解顯示，醫院層級與國家層級因素解釋了手術品質變異中76%的可解釋部分。
結論：急診手術在全球範圍內與切緣陽性切除風險增加二至三倍相關，且不受資源可用性影響，凸顯全球外科實務中一個被忽視的領域。此發現挑戰了「急診手術後較差預後係因疾病分期較晚所致」之假設。對於以急診方式呈現且具潛在治癒性可切除性之病人，加強可切除性之決策判斷、確保專科醫師之可近性，以及發展手術橋接路徑，代表可立即施行且低成本之全球癌症預後改善策略。
papers.score_reason: 樣本量龐大且跨國多層次校正分析嚴謹，但為觀察性研究，切緣陽性為替代指標，且急診手術本身可能存在無法完全校正的適應症混淆。
papers.relevance_why: 台灣屬高收入國家組別，急診大腸直腸癌手術品質議題確實存在，但本文核心為全球健康體系差異，非直接技術性介入研究。

papers.action: 急診呈現但仍具潛在治癒性之大腸直腸癌病人，應盡量安排專科大腸直腸外科醫師手術，並考慮橋接策略（如支架、造口轉流）以優化切除品質。

pico.O: 主要：切緣陽性切除率；次要：依國家收入層級、癌症分期、腫瘤位置之效應修飾，以及變異數分解

papers.title: FUT2-mediated α1,2-fucosylation in inflammatory bowel disease: mechanisms and translational potential
papers.authors: Chen J, Gan L, Zhang S, Liao S, Lv L
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) arises from complex interactions among genetic susceptibility, immune dysregulation, the intestinal microbiota and environmental factors. Fucosyltransferase 2 (FUT2) regulates mucosal α1,2-fucosylation and the expression of histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs), thereby shaping host-microbe interactions at the intestinal surface. Loss-of-function FUT2 variants define the non-secretor phenotype and have been linked to IBD susceptibility and altered microbial communities. This review summarizes current evidence on FUT2 in IBD, including epithelial glycosylation-microbiota crosstalk, immune and barrier regulation, metabolite-related inflammatory pathways, intestinal stem-cell biology, and enteric nervous system/VIP-related signaling. We also evaluate translational strategies, including functional compensation with the FUT2-dependent human milk oligosaccharide 2'-fucosyllactose (2'-FL), secretor-status-stratified interventions, and preclinical approaches such as L-fucose and D-serine. Overall, FUT2 is an important node connecting host glycosylation, microbial ecology and intestinal immune homeostasis, but its value as a direct therapeutic or biomarker target in IBD remains exploratory. Most mechanistic and causal evidence currently derives from mouse models. Although human genetic and microbiome association data are relatively robust, interventional clinical evidence remains limited, which represents a major barrier to clinical translation.

papers.title_zh: FUT2媒介的α1,2-岩藻糖基化在發炎性腸道疾病中的角色：機制與轉譯潛力
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）源自遺傳易感性、免疫失調、腸道微生物群與環境因子間複雜的交互作用。岩藻糖基轉移酶2（FUT2）調控黏膜α1,2-岩藻糖基化及組織血型抗原（HBGAs）的表現，進而形塑腸道表面宿主與微生物的交互作用。FUT2功能喪失變異型定義了非分泌型表型，並與IBD易感性及微生物群落改變有關。本綜述總結目前關於FUT2在IBD中的證據，包括上皮醣基化-微生物群交互作用、免疫與屏障調控、代謝物相關發炎路徑、腸幹細胞生物學，以及腸神經系統/VIP相關訊號傳遞。我們也評估轉譯策略，包括以FUT2依賴性人乳寡糖2'-岩藻糖基乳糖（2'-FL）進行功能補償、依分泌者狀態分層的介入措施，以及L-岩藻糖與D-絲胺酸等臨床前研究方法。整體而言，FUT2是連結宿主醣基化、微生物生態與腸道免疫恆定的重要節點，但其作為IBD直接治療或生物標記靶點的價值仍屬探索階段。目前大多數機制與因果證據來自小鼠模型。雖然人類遺傳學與微生物群關聯數據相對穩健，但介入性臨床證據仍有限，這是臨床轉譯的主要障礙。

papers.title: HELICOBACTER PYLORI BEYOND THE STOMACH: WHEN THE STORY CHANGES
papers.authors: Sanches B, Chaves S, Marinho F, Cançado G, Terra D, Coelho M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is well known as an etiological agent in several gastric diseases, including chronic gastritis, gastric and duodenal ulcers, gastric carcinoma, and lymphoma. Over the past decades, the understanding of its pathogenic role has evolved substantially, overcoming initial skepticism and establishing the bacterium as a major factor in gastroduodenal disease. However, epidemiological and experimental studies suggest that this chronic infection may also be associated with a variety of extragastric conditions.
OBJECTIVE: This review aims to evaluate the relationship between H. pylori infection and anemia, immune thrombocytopenic purpura, colorectal cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and neurological disorders.
METHODS: For each association, the most recent evidence and current recommendations regarding the diagnosis and treatment of H. pylori infection during the clinical course of these conditions were assessed.
CONCLUSION: Further prospective studies are needed to clarify whether these associations represent causal relationships with clinical relevance or merely statistical correlations, and to better determine the impact of H. pylori infection on extragastric diseases.

papers.title_zh: 幽門螺旋桿菌超越胃部：當故事改變之時
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：幽門螺旋桿菌（H. pylori）作為多種胃部疾病的致病因子已廣為人知，包括慢性胃炎、胃及十二指腸潰瘍、胃癌與淋巴瘤。過去數十年間，對其致病角色的理解已大幅演進，克服了最初的懷疑，確立此菌為胃十二指腸疾病的主要因子。然而，流行病學與實驗研究顯示，此慢性感染也可能與多種胃外疾病有關。目的：本綜述旨在評估H. pylori感染與貧血、免疫性血小板減少性紫斑症、大腸直腸癌、心血管疾病及神經系統疾病之間的關聯。方法：針對每一項關聯，評估最新證據以及在這些疾病臨床病程中，對H. pylori感染診斷與治療的現行建議。結論：仍需進一步的前瞻性研究來釐清這些關聯是否代表具有臨床意義的因果關係，或僅僅是統計相關性，並更好地確定H. pylori感染對胃外疾病的影響。

papers.context: 前作為168人回溯性世代研究，發現H. pylori陽性與mCRC病人較長OS相關但伴隨混淆因子。本綜述將H. pylori-CRC關聯置於更廣泛胃外疾病脈絡中討論，但未針對存活預後提供具體佐證或反駁，僅重申因果關係仍待釐清。
